newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower after renewing 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower after renewing 1997 high.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended the Friday session marginally lower, as morning gains on the June futures and options settlement which lifted the benchmark to a new high for calendar 1997 melted after profit-taking ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 finished 36.11 points or 0.18 percent lower at 20,528.35. Its September futures ended flat at 20,590.

"The market spent most of its energy on the settlement this morning," said Katsunichi Shimizu, general manager at Yamaichi Securities. "It's Friday and there were no extremely strong buy incentives and trade slowed down in the afternoon."
